full_media.name: GS-2 medium
full_media.notes: Medium adjusted with 10 M NaOH to final pH of 7.2. Different carbon sources used: cellobiose (CB), microcrystalline cellulose (MCC), alkaline-pretreated switchgrass (alSG), alkaline-pretreated corn stover (alCS), dilute acid-pretreated corn stover (acCS), and glucose. 400 mL medium in 0.5 L serum bottles, boiled and flushed with nitrogen, sealed and autoclaved at 121°C for 20 min. Inoculated with C. thermocellum DSM1313. Incubated for 48 h in 60°C shaking incubator. Glucose-based media required preliminary adaptation with seven successive re-inoculation steps.

provenance.reference_title: How does cellulosome composition  influence deconstruction of lignocellulosic  substrates in Clostridium (Ruminiclostridium)  thermocellum DSM 1313?
